acceptance_oracle: When a profile owner records an application status, note, or external application report, the Activity timeline shows a stable safe summary for the matching application after reload, only in that profile. User reports remain attributed as user reports; note text and raw audit payload never appear; no employer receipt or actual MJobs submission is inferred.
red_observation: Before this slice, the tracking API persisted APPLICATION_PIPELINE_STATUS and APPLICATION_NOTE against a profile/application-scoped tracking entity, but GET /profiles/fixture/audit-history returned neither event. The new regression failed because both expected event types were absent.
implementation: The audit read model now resolves profile-bound application tracking entity IDs back to the owner application before selecting visible events.
Fixed allowlisted summaries expose application status reports, notes, and external-application reports without serializing note text, event payloads, request IDs, or other private details.
External user reports display as APPLICATION_REPORTED with explicit user-report wording; no APPLICATION_SUBMITTED or employer confirmation claim is emitted.
